title: PUT /api/areas/{area_id}/entities/{entity_id} (body)
description: Admin only (CSRF like every admin write). Partial update of an area entity placement: only the fields sent change. tile replaces the whole object; tile: null resets every tile setting to the default (the hub stores NULL). The hub checks tile against data/tile-capabilities.json for the domain of entity_id and against Home Assistant (run target and secondary sensor must exist; 503 ha_unavailable when Home Assistant cannot be asked, nothing is stored). Errors: 422 with detail[].type = tile.<reason> and detail[].loc = ["body", "tile", ...]: tile.field_not_allowed, tile.variant_not_allowed, tile.attribute_not_allowed, tile.action_not_allowed, tile.icon_unknown, tile.target_required, tile.target_domain, tile.target_not_found, tile.entity_not_found, tile.hidden_everywhere, tile.too_large. Unknown keys (also inside tile) = 422. Answer: the placement (common/area-entity.json, tile as object). Broadcast entity_updated with changed (ws/broadcast/entity_updated.json).

display_name.description: Trimmed; empty or only blanks = null (name from Home Assistant).

tile.description: Whole tile object (replaces the stored one) or null = reset to default. Strict: only the writable fields of defs.json#/$defs/tile_settings_base.
